Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one food sprite atlas for DALHA's lightweight menu thumbnails.
Create ONE landscape atlas with EXACTLY 7 columns and 4 rows: 28 distinct miniature food illustrations. Image aspect ratio 7:4, ideally 1792 by 1024. Each cell equal sized. Warm white clean background, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no cutlery decoration, no watermark. Each meal is entirely isolated and centered in its cell with generous empty margin of at least 15% on EVERY side. Nothing crosses a cell boundary; objects never touch. Distinct small bowl/plate or sandwich shown in a soft realistic flat illustration style, 3/4 overhead view, recognizable colorful ingredients, restrained soft shadows. Korean food should be accurately depicted. Keep multi-component meals together within their one cell, with smaller accompanying bread/egg/glass as appropriate. This is one atlas asset for slicing; precise grid and ordering essential. Do not make a restaurant menu poster.
Row-major food subjects, left to right:
ROW 1: 1. 그릭요거트·저당 그래놀라·베리 ; 2. 그릭요거트·바나나·견과류 ; 3. 오트밀·사과·견과류 ; 4. 계란후라이와 통밀토스트 ; 5. 토마토 에그스크램블·무가당 차 ; 6. 버섯 에그스크램블·통밀빵 ; 7. 닭가슴살 에그샌드위치
ROW 2: 1. 감자 에그샌드위치 ; 2. 햄치즈 통밀토스트·커피 ; 3. 땅콩버터 통밀토스트 ; 4. 북엇국과 밥 ; 5. 단호박 달걀찜 ; 6. 고구마·삶은 달걀·우유 ; 7. 블루베리 두유 견과 스무디
ROW 3: 1. 케일 바나나 사과 요거트 스무디 ; 2. 블루베리 검은콩 스무디·삶은 달걀 ; 3. 케일 바나나 두유 스무디 ; 4. 당근 사과주스·달걀치즈 토스트 ; 5. 달걀 오차즈케 ; 6. 닭다리살 구이 포케 ; 7. 참치 포케
ROW 4: 1. 새우 포케 ; 2. 소고기 불고기 포케 ; 3. 두부버섯 포케 ; 4. 닭고기 현미비빔밥 ; 5. 소고기 나물비빔밥 ; 6. 두부 나물비빔밥 ; 7. 보리밥 된장찌개
No visible text. Every row has exactly seven illustrations.

accepted_edit: Edit this food atlas as a production-ready WEB sprite sheet. It has 7 columns and 4 rows. Keep all 28 foods, their order and their locations. TWO precise corrections: (1) Make ALL background outside the food/plates a perfectly SOLID OPAQUE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Remove every black patch, yellow fringe, speckle and jagged noise outside the plates. Do NOT make transparency. No transparent pixels. No black background anywhere between plates. Clean solid white gutters separating the 28 meals. Preserve the black SEAWEED and black COOKING BOWLS that belong to the foods. (2) The top row third bowl is 순두부 달걀탕: change only this soup to CLEAR ivory broth with white soft tofu and yellow egg wisps, NO red/orange broth. All other food ingredients unchanged. The image must have a clean white background suitable for a white website, like a product catalog. Keep the exact 7x4 grid. No words or labels.
